LIST daily-note maintenance, note/folder rename backlink rewrites and Project delete unbinding mutate entities indirectly before visible primary write.
Hardcoded native authorityEpoch 1 and file writability policy cannot enforce shared authority or resource revocation.
Filesystem PID lease is not sync_delivery_lease; its 10-second acquisition wait cannot serve as partition policy bound.
DB policy and CRDT WAL not atomic; check-then-append/rename or check-then-push races survive if no serialized durable fence boundary.
HTML source-action grant revocation is not resource ACL revoke; render lease and push() return do not prove durable broadcast fence.

Common commands files repeat across packages; independent creation/replacement would violate single-owner foundation integration.
